text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Health status: 37.5°C (normal), no body pain.
Meals: Attached records for 3 meals + 2 snacks.
Notes: Signs of skin irritation on cheeks."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Cause: Presumed to be temperature fluctuations due to unstable weather
Impact on training: None
Ointment applied, monitoring progress"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If no improvement is seen,
I will consult with Trainer-san once more."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...This should suffice for my report
to Trainer.
Now, the medicine should be in that drawer over there...

Having finished writing her daily report, Air Messiah
looked at her dry skin in the mirror
and let her brows droop with a sigh.
